contacts.name: ShannieZhong IV
contacts.signature: Guess if I'm short on the Metal element in my astrological chart?

150590101.text: "To the great Nameless, Arbiter of the wispae's destiny..."

150590102.text: "Your dear Grove Investigation Shroom has run into a bit of difficulty, so he asked our mutual acquaintance Ms. Zhong to send this message on his behalf."

150590103.text: "Just as you're guessing right now, there are still no rewards in this version. Plans change, so if your heart is set on this card set, you'll just have to wait a little longer."

150590104.text: "Planarcadia is facing an enormous crisis, like some fictional doomsday scenario straight out of Star Rabbit. May we both have enough good fortune to meet again when peace is restored."

150590105.text: (I'd still prefer it if you sent this on my behalf. {F#She}{M#He} might be confused if I suddenly sent out a message from my account. I will compensate for this.)
